Prioritize Workers & Pages; official `wrangler`. Always start with `wrangler generate`.
npx wrangler generate my-worker --type=module --ts
npx create-cloudflare@latest my-fullstack-app --framework next
Monorepos: `pnpm` or `yarn workspaces`; centralize dependencies/build scripts: `"workspaces": ["apps/*", "packages/*"]`.
Secrets: `wrangler.toml` or Cloudflare dashboard;
